metadata.title: mm doesn't correctly check shape of GPU inputs

bug_description:
## 🐛 Bug





Setting default tensor type to `torch.cuda.DoubleTensor` results in undefined behavior (and wrong outputs) in case of shape mismatch.



When passing a tensor of shape `(1, 1)` to a `nn.Linear(2, 1)`, it gives unpredictable results when using `torch.cuda.DoubleTenosr` as default. However, if using CPU tensor, it will give a *shape mismatch* error (as expected)

trigger_conditions.condition: Calling matrix multiplication operators with incompatible inner dimensions, where tensor shapes violate mathematical multiplication constraints.
trigger_conditions.operation_context: Passing CUDA tensors with incompatible shapes to torch.mm, e.g. shapes that do not satisfy (m,k) and (k,n), as occurs through nn.Linear when default tensor type is set to a CUDA type.

failure_behavior.description: Passing CUDA tensors with incompatible shapes to torch.mm, e.g. shapes that do not satisfy (m,k) and (k,n), as occurs through nn.Linear when default tensor type is set to a CUDA type.
